title: Morgan Reyes
about: I'm currently the Global Talent Partner at Ivo, where I joined as their Founding Recruiter (employee #4) and scaled the team from 4 to 150.
Before this, I studied Human Development and Psychology at Harvard University, where I did three internships in recruiting and people operations — two of them at early-stage startups.

My love for recruiting and early-stage startups started during undergrad, working at AIESEC — the world's largest youth-led nonprofit developing leadership through international opportunities — where I ran people operations (hiring, retention, training, development) for a cohort of 160 students. From there, I joined Intellemo, an AI-powered video creation platform for businesses, as their Founding Recruiter during my third year of undergrad.
interests: Hiring systems — structured interviews, scorecards, and how to make a process fair without making it soulless.
Compensation design, especially the tension between internal equity and staying competitive for scarce roles.
Manager development. Most companies promote their best individual contributor and call it leadership training.
People analytics, used carefully — attrition and engagement data can tell real stories, but they lie easily if you let them.
The parts of company culture that get built by accident versus the parts anyone actually designed on purpose.
